fields.mechanism: Using a photovoltaic (PV) panel directly connected to heating elements to form a "PTC hot plate" for efficient cooking.
fields.intervention: Implement a similar direct connection of a high-efficiency solar panel to a heating element or a thermoelectric converter to increase the efficiency of the solar panel.
fields.expected_effect: Achieve a higher efficiency rate than the current world record of 22.4%, potentially exceeding 50% or more.
fields.falsification_test: Measure the efficiency of the modified solar panel under controlled conditions, comparing it to the current world record of 22.4% and verifying that the new design does not decrease efficiency.
fields.mechanism_source_span: "An Arduino controller manages the load and records system data (current, voltage, power, and temperature)."
